sources.authority_reason: Original authors or official upstream source, retrieved and personally inspected for this review.
sources.inspection_note: Personally read sections 2.1–2.2.3 and 2.3.1–2.3.2. Neither means training RL from random weights nor that the toy model reproduces R1 abilities.
